Scope: phase 1 of the logistics area. Wet networks (sewerage, storm, potable water, fire fighting and TSE, including the force main), dry networks (medium voltage, low voltage, street lighting and telecom), the potable water pump station, the sewage lift station, guard rooms, all road layers up to the asphalt wearing course, and landscape.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At the 24-Nov-2026 data date the project is 71.9% complete against 89.2% planned, 17.4% behind the plan (SPI 0.81). It gained 3.5% this week against 2.9% planned, so the gap narrowed for the second week running, from 17.9% to 17.4%.

With 88.0% of the contract time gone, 28.1% of the work remains. Finishing by the contract completion date of 29-Jan-2027 needs about 3.1% a week over the 9 whole weeks left. This week's 3.5% beat that rate, but 22% of the man-hours earned were testing and commissioning, including 4,219 on street lighting, whose construction is only 35% done (see Data notes). The weekly report's milestone sheet and the P6 update now forecast project handover on 05-Apr-2027, 66 days late, a week later again than last week's forecast. Construction is the weak phase: 61.8% done against 97.5% planned.

Weights are budgeted man-hours. Of the 32,037 man-hours earned this week, 23,785 (74%) were construction, which gained 4.5%, led by fire fighting, low voltage, potable water and TSE; potable water and fire fighting are now slightly ahead of their plans. Testing and commissioning earned 7,013 man-hours (22%), 4,219 of them on street lighting. The sewage lift station lost 85 man-hours (procurement lowered) and landscape gained 0.3%. The P6 update (data date 24-Nov-2026) has 4,851 activities: 3,196 completed, 407 in progress and 1,248 not started. Failed-start activities fell from 1,155 to 1,130.

The P6 update finishes the project on 05-Apr-2027, 66 days after the contract completion date. Most P6 milestones moved another 7 days later with the data date: construction finish to 11-Feb-2027, the asphalt wearing course to 26-Jan-2027 (5 days of float) and the pump and lift stations to 06 and 13-Jan-2027. Two networks finish earlier than last week: TSE on 22-Dec-2026 (previously 14-Jan-2027) and fire fighting on 16-Dec-2026 (previously 30-Dec-2026); the P6 date shown for wet networks is now sewerage, 05-Jan-2027, and for electrical works telecom, 11-Jan-2027. The storm water finish milestone (25-Nov-2026) is still open with the network at 99.5%. The schedule has no finish constraint at the contract date, so its float is measured against its own late finish. Other forecasts in this week's files: 21-Mar-2027 (General Information sheet), 22-Dec-2026 (acceleration plan in the progress presentation) and 30-Nov-2026 (look-ahead sheet and the presentation's target date).

Share of each long-lead item delivered to site. Source: procurement tracking sheet 24-Nov-2026. By discipline (procurement summary in the weekly report), 130 of 160 materials are on site, the same as last week: civil and roads 71 of 82, electrical 24 of 30, mechanical 35 of 48.

80 more street-light poles arrivedStreet-light poles delivered rose from 377 to 457 of 565, the only new delivery in the tracking sheet this week. The weekly report's procurement summary did not change: 130 of 160 materials on site and 154 of 160 purchase orders placed.
Pump-station equipment and hydrants still outstandingThe cranes and fuel pumps, due 20-Nov-2026, are now overdue with nothing delivered. Only 13 of 82 fire hydrants are delivered against a date of 07-Jul-2026. Planned delivery completion: 27-Nov-2026 (electrical), 28-Nov-2026 (mechanical), 09-Dec-2026 (civil and roads). Materials approval: 149 of 160 approved, 1 pending.

Data notes

  • Report week: the weekly report states "Current Contract Weeks: 69 of 78" (Milestones sheet). The report serial number (WPR051) and the consultant's inspection number (51) are not the week number.
  • This-week values compare this report with the 17-Nov-2026 report (previous week folder).
  • Procurement in the P6 update, checked again after last week's finding of 248 open procurement activities with no progress: this update completes 67 of them, but 181 are still open, 173 of them at the same % complete as last week, and 5 were lowered from 95% to 90% (DI pipes, double-flanged DI pipes, odour control unit, surge tanks, JIB crane). 8 open procurement activities still precede 14 construction activities that are already complete (9 and 16 last week): the guard-room masonry, uPVC and PPR pipes, scupper, clean-out and floor drain, the Zone 03 street-light luminaires and the dripper materials. The issue is only partly fixed.
  • Testing and commissioning: 7,013 of the 32,037 man-hours earned this week are testing and commissioning, 4,219 of them on street lighting, where the tests are 46.8% done while street-lighting construction is 34.9% done; the phase is 47.9% done against 9.1% planned. The Testing sheet now gives actual start dates between 02 and 19-Nov-2026 for the potable water, fire-fighting, TSE and street-lighting tests in Zones 02 to 04, but the Zone 01 potable water, fire-fighting and TSE tests still show "actual" starts of 11 and 12-Jan-2027, and the Zone 03 TSE test 26-Nov-2026, after the data date.
  • Four different completion forecasts: 21-Mar-2027 (General Information sheet, −51 days, the same as the Milestones sheet's "ready for initial handover"), 05-Apr-2027 (Milestones sheet and P6 update, −66 days), 22-Dec-2026 (acceleration plan in the progress presentation) and 30-Nov-2026 (look-ahead sheet and the presentation's "target" date). The forecast for "Complete submittals and place order for all long-lead items" is blank this week (shown as 00:00:00 with a change of 46,289 days).
